fact: The IMF mission chief and project lead say Guinea-Bissau launched a blockchain public payroll platform in May 2024 under its IMF ECF programme, which could track all 26,600 civil servants and 8,100 pensioners by November 2024.
The IMF project lead says the new blockchain payroll ledger platform was launched successfully in May 2024, after four years of work with the Fund and Ernst & Young.
